The '''Alagon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
The [[Xeran Mining Corporation]] ran a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation in the system and initially employed [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] workers, who were ultimately fired and replaced with [[HND-9 mining droid]]s. The former miners created the [[Worker's Militia]] and staged an uprising against the corporation, attacking [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that attempted to leave the system. Eventually, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] intervened and ended the conflict.
